graph_metadata.description: Normalized graph: canonical ingredients + equipment nodes. Auto-merged near-duplicates.

nodes.name: Lemon Orzo Soup
nodes.assembly_instructions: 1. In stockpot over medium-high heat, heat oil. Add onion, celery, carrot and garlic. Sauté until onion is translucent, 3-5 minutes. Stir in base. 2. Add water, salt, thyme, pepper and bay leaves. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat. Cover. Simmer 20-25 minutes. 3. Stir in chicken and lemon juice. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat. Discard bay leaves. 4. Cover. Keep hot for service. 5. At time of service, stir in Orzo and parsley. Heat through.

nodes.name: Newcomb Grilled Chicken Parmesan Sandwich
nodes.assembly_instructions: 1. Heat Spaghetti Sauce to 140 F. FOR 1 SERVING: 1. Layer the following on bottom half of 1 Baguette: 1 piece Grilled Chicken 1-oz spoodle Spaghetti Sauce 1 tbl Parmesan cheese 1 slice provolone cheese Close baguette. 2. Cover. Keep hot for service.

nodes.name: Ranch Potato Chips
nodes.assembly_instructions: 1. Preheat deep-fat fryer to 350 F. 2. Combine sugar and dressing mix. Whisk until well blended. Set aside. 3. Place 1 lb frozen potato chips in fryer basket. Fry 1 minute. Stir. Place 2nd fryer basket on top of chips to keep them submerged. Fry until golden, 2 minutes. Drain. 4. Sprinkle 1 tbl + 2 tsp sugar mixture over chips. Toss to coat. 5. On parchment-lined full sheet pan(s), spread chips. Cool. 6. Cover. Hold at room temperature for service or use as directed in recipe.
nodes.special_instructions: Place fryer basket on sheet pan to fill. DO NOT fill basket over fryer. DO NOT fill fryer basket more than 1/3 full.

nodes.name: Iceberg Lettuce
nodes.special_instructions: IDDSI Level 7 1-oz spoodle = 1/4 ozw 2-oz spoodle = 1/2 ozw 3-oz spoodle = 3/4 ozw 4-oz spoodle = 1 ozw 6-oz spoodle = 1 1/2 ozw 8-oz spoodle = 2 ozw

nodes.name: Black Bean Soup
nodes.assembly_instructions: 1. In stockpot over medium-high heat, heat oil. Add onion, celery, green pepper and garlic. Saute until onion is translucent, 3 to 5 minutes. Add cumin. Saute until aromatic, 1 to 2 minutes. Stir in base. 2. Add remaining ingredients. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat. Cover. Simmer 15 minutes. Discard bay leaves. 3. Puree 1/2 of soup. Return pureed mixture to remaining soup. Mix well. Return to a boil. Reduce heat. Simmer 5 minutes. 4. Cover. Keep hot for service.

nodes.name: Mushroom Barley Soup
nodes.assembly_instructions: 1. In stockpot over medium-high heat, heat oil. Add onion, celery, carrot and leek. Saute until onion is translucent, 3 to 5 minutes. 2. Add mushrooms. Saute 4 minutes. Stir in base. 3. Add remaining ingredients. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat. Simmer until barley is tender, 45 to 50 minutes. Discard bay leaves. 4. Cover. Keep hot for service.

nodes.name: Chipotle Chicken Tortilla Soup
nodes.assembly_instructions: 1. In stockpot over medium-high heat, heat oil. Add onion and garlic. Saute until onion is translucent, 3 to 5 minutes. 2. Add chili powder, cumin, oregano and black pepper. Saute until spices are aromatic, 1 to 2 minutes. 3. Stir in tomato paste and chipotle concentrate. Saute 3 minutes. Stir in base. 4. Add water, Roasted Corn, beans, diced tomato and salt. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat. Simmer 15 minutes. 5. Add chicken. Cook until heated through. 6. Cover. Keep hot for service. 6. At time of service, stir in cilantro. 7. Serve 2-oz spoodle Tortilla Straws with each serving of soup.

nodes.name: Chicken Gumbo with Brown Rice
nodes.assembly_instructions: 1. In stockpot over medium-high heat, saute bacon until lightly browned, 3 to 5 minutes. Add margarine. Heat until melted. 2. Add onion, celery, green pepper and garlic. Saute until onion is translucent, 3 to 5 minutes. 3. Reduce heat to medium. Add flour. Whisk until well blended. Cook, whisking often, until golden brown, 5 to 8 minutes. Stir in base. 4. Add remaining ingredients except okra and Brown Rice. Whisk until well blended. 5. Cook, whisking constantly, until mixture thickens and boils. Reduce heat. Simmer 20 minutes. 6. Add frozen okra. Return to a boil. Reduce heat. Simmer until okra is tender, 3 to 4 minutes. Discard bay leaves. 7. Cover. Keep hot for service. 8. At time of service, stir in Brown Rice. Cook until heated through.

nodes.name: Chicken Noodle Soup
nodes.assembly_instructions: 1. In stockpot over medium-high heat, heat oil. Add onion, celery, carrot and garlic. Saute until onion is translucent, 3 to 5 minutes. Stir in base. 2. Add water, salt, pepper, thyme and bay leaves. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat. Cover. Simmer 20 minutes. 3. Add Chicken. Return to a boil. Reduce heat. Simmer 10 minutes. Discard bay leaves. 4. Cover. Keep hot for service. 5. At time of service, stir in Egg Noodles and parsley. Cook until heated through.

nodes.name: New England Clam Chowder
nodes.assembly_instructions: 1. In stockpot over medium-high heat, melt margarine. Add bacon. Saute until lightly browned, 3 to 5 minutes. Add onion and celery. Saute until onion is translucent, 3 to 5 minutes. 2. Reduce heat to medium. Add flour. Whisk until well blended. Cook, whisking often, 4 minutes. Do not brown. Stir in base. 3. Add milk and water. Whisk until well blended. Cook, whisking constantly, until mixture thickens and boils. 4. Add remaining ingredients except clams and parsley. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat. Simmer until potato is tender, 20 to 25 minutes. Discard bay leaves. 5. Add clams. Return to a simmer. Simmer 3 minutes. DO NOT BOIL. 6. Cover. Keep hot for service. 7. At time of service, stir in parsley.

nodes.name: Tomato Basil Soup
nodes.assembly_instructions: 1. Place soup in specified packaging with label. 2. Keep chilled for service.

nodes.name: Moroccan Chickpea Soup
nodes.assembly_instructions: 1. In stockpot over medium heat, cook paprika, cumin, cayenne pepper and cinnamon, stirring constantly, until aromatic, 20 to 30 seconds. 2. Increase heat to medium-high. Heat oil. Add onion, carrot, celery and garlic. Saute until onion is translucent, 3 to 5 minutes. Stir in tomato paste and base. 3. Add remaining ingredients except spinach and lemon juice. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat. Simmer until potato is tender, 10 to 15 minutes. Discard bay leaves. 4. Add spinach and lemon juice. Cook until heated through. 5. Cover. Keep hot for service.

nodes.name: Chimichurri Potato Salad
nodes.assembly_instructions: 1. Preheat steamer. 2. In perforated steam table pan(s), steam potatoes until fork-tender, 8 to 10 minutes. Drain. Chill. 3. Combine potatoes and Chimichurri. Toss to coat. 4. Cover. Keep chilled for service or use as directed in recipe.

nodes.name: Spinach Artichoke Panini
nodes.assembly_instructions: 1. Preheat panini press to 400 F. FOR 1 SERVING: 1. Spread level #24 scoop Spinach Artichoke Dip on 2 pieces of bread. 2. Layer the following on 1 piece of bread: 1 piece provolone cheese 2-oz spoodle spinach 1 slice provolone cheese 2nd slice of bread 3. Coat panini press with cooking spray. 4. Place sandwich in panini press. Cook until sandwich is browned and cheese is melted, 3 to 4 minutes. 5. Keep hot for service.

nodes.name: Pickled Red Onion
nodes.assembly_instructions: 1. Combine all ingredients. Mix well. 2. Cover. Refrigerate overnight. 3. Keep chilled for service or use as directed in recipe. Drain before using.
nodes.special_instructions: 1 tbl = 3/8 oz 1-oz spoodle = 5/8 oz 2-oz spoodle = 1 1/8 oz 3-oz spoodle = 1 3/4 oz 4-oz spoodle = 2 1/4 oz 6-oz spoodle = 3 3/8 oz 8-oz spoodle = 4 1/2 oz
